messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: loading large data
parts:
How much physical memory (RAM) do you have? Might be just running out of physical memory - R generally needs to load all data into memory. In a fresh R console, try:

> ds <- read.csv("file:///C:/Temp/claim prediction/train_set.csv")

to check whether it is R or whether Rattle is adding some overhead.

Thanks,
Graham
